title: bhayya tere chehlum ke lie aayi hai zainab
body:
bhayya tere chehlum ke lie aayi hai zainab
dukh paayi hai dukh paayi hai dukh paayi hai zainab
zinda'n me lahad baali sakina ki banaakar
bhai ki amaanat ko tahe qaak chupaakar
<<DIVIDER>>
saath apne lute qaafele ko laai hai zainab
maajaye ke marqad pe ye dukhya ka tha nouha
aayi hai behen milne ko utho mere bhayya
bin tere har ek gaam pe dukh paai hai zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
bhayya tumhi batlaao watan jaake karu kya
soughra tumhe puchegi to bolo mai kahu kya
jab bhi ye qayaal aata hai ghabraai hai zainab
bemaqnao chaadar gayi baazaaro me bhayya
<<DIVIDER>>
darbare yazeedi me gayi duqtare zahra
tha hukm jo tera wo baja laai hai zainab
har toote hue dil ko sahara bhi diya hai
har dard me kunbe ko dilaasa bhi diya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
har haal me har bibi ko samjhaai hai zainab
ranjo alamo yaas hai abbas nahi hai
juz abide beemar koi paas nahi hai
bas ek amaanat ye bacha laai hai zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
faryaad kuna bhai ki turbat pe behen hai
ab qaahare shabbir ka nouha ye *hassan* hai
har gaam pe tanhaai ka gham khaai hai zainab
